item.title: Jordan Spence made one of the most embarrassing plays of the year
item.description: Not a good look for Jordan Spence. The Senators defenseman ripped a puck after the whistle Thursday night and drilled his own teammate Tim Stützle.

item.title: Tkachuk under fire after controversial hit on Martinook sparks outrage
item.description: Brady Tkachuk speared Jordan Martinook Thursday night, and somehow walked away with two minutes. A major penalty like that normally means an ejection and a hearing.

item.title: Green calls out the NHL after scary Sanderson injury sparks outrage
item.description: Travis Green didn’t hide his anger Thursday, blasting the officials and the league over Taylor Hall’s two-minute minor for a headshot on Jake Sanderson.

item.title: Sabres rollerblade gang goes viral after Boston crowd turns on them
item.description: Tage Thompson and Lindy Ruff watched the mood around Buffalo shift once the series left home ice.

item.title: NHL player safety announces suspension decision after violent Thursday night incident
item.description: Jake Sanderson left Ottawa reeling, and Travis Green wasn't buying the league's no-punishment call on Taylor Hall.

item.title: Deadly LaGuardia Airport crash overshadows Monday night's Rangers-Senators game at MSG
item.description: Brady Tkachuk and Travis Green were supposed to headline Monday night at MSG, but Ottawa's trip into New York suddenly feels a lot bigger than hockey.

item.title: Spruce Grove and Salmon Arm's game explodes into a chaotic full-line brawl
item.description: Daniel Dirracolo's night blew up fast as Tyler Shattock's Silverbacks got dragged into a wild line brawl with Martin Lachine's Saints.

item.title: The Sabres' goalie plan could become one of the playoffs' biggest wild cards
item.description: Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen is rolling while Lindy Ruff now has a real decision to make in the Buffalo Sabres crease.

item.title: One Martin St-Louis decision could cost Cole Caufield the Maurice Richard TrophyScore
item.description: Cole Caufield and Martin St-Louis are driving a breakout season, but one late-game decision could cost him the Maurice-Richard Trophy.

item.title: Ottawa Senators hit with major blow as long-term injury status is confirmed.
item.description: Thomas Chabot has Travis Green staring at a blue-line mess after Ottawa learned he will be out for a while.

item.title: Brady Tkachuk in deep hot water after ugly comments bite him right back
item.description: Brady Tkachuk blasted the Maple Leafs after Auston Matthews got clipped, then Ottawa stayed quiet when Thomas Chabot got drilled and left hurt.

item.title: Major announcement from the Avalanche before tonight's game
item.description: Logan O'Connor returns to the Colorado Avalanche lineup Tuesday, nearly 10 months after injury, giving the club a jolt deep in the roster.

item.title: The surprise of the year is confirmed in the NHL
item.description: Egor Chinakhov has given Dan Muse exactly what he needed in Pittsburgh, a jolt of offense that reshaped the Penguins forward group.

item.title: Big McCarron KOs Corey Perry with a lethal uppercut that leaves him bloodied
item.description: Michael McCarron gave John Hynes' Wild a jolt when he went right at Corey Perry in a nasty exchange Tuesday night.

item.title: Devils hold breath as Sheldon Keefe waits on Arseny Gritsyuk injury news
item.description: Arseny Gritsyuk left mid-game as Sheldon Keefe now waits on imaging after a sudden exit to the tunnel.
